messages:
maya: Quick sync 1 — dropping updated mock for the Credentials drawer empty state + revoke/rotate error copy. Need copy + a11y nits. Empty state feels cold; revoke failure is too scary. Thoughts?

devin: Love the layout. Quick nit: change CTA copy to 'Create API key' instead of 'Get started'. Be explicit. Also reduce the hero icon size on mobile.

sam: Agree on CTA. Revoke failure currently prefixed with 'Error:' 1 Can we soften to 'Unable to revoke key' and append reason if available, e.g. 'Unable to revoke key 1 network error. Try again.'

karla: a11y: revoke failure needs aria-live="assertive" toast so screen readers are notified. Inline-only alerts aren't announced. Also after a failed revoke, move keyboard focus to the retry button or the inline message.

maya: Will do: inline message + dismissible toast. Focus shift to retry in drawer flows; only trap focus for modal. Adding aria-live and tab-order notes to the mock.

devin: Tone: current 'Revoke failed 1 critical error, contact support' is too alarmist. Suggest: 'We couldn't revoke this key. Try again or contact support if the issue persists.'

sam: +1. Add microcopy under revoke CTA: 'Active sessions may persist for a few minutes.' Sets expectations.

maya: For empty state we considered two variants: (A) product-led: 'Create an API key to start using the Redwood API' with short use cases; (B) minimal: 'No API keys yet. Create one to get started.' Which works?

devin: Use (A) for brand-new orgs (helps conversion), (B) for orgs with existing usage but no keys. Suggest context-aware copy: if org usage==0 show A else B.

karla: If we do context-aware, ensure the longer copy is max 3 lines at mobile. CTA must have visible focus ring and 4.5:1 contrast.

sam: Accessibility nit: 'Show secret' is a text link now. Make it a button with aria-pressed when toggled and keyboard-focusable.

maya: Noted. Also permission handling: instead of hiding the Create CTA for non-creators, show a disabled CTA with tooltip 'You need admin permissions to create API keys' and link to docs. Discoverability is key.

devin: Disabled CTA + keyboard-accessible tooltip works. Tooltip should open via keyboard (enter/space). Include docs link.

sam: In prototype testing, some users thought 'Rotate key' would rename the key. Consider 'Rotate credentials' or add a hint: 'Generates a new secret and invalidates the old one.'

karla: For SRs, include that hint in an offscreen aria-describedby so it's read when rotate button gets focus.

maya: Rotate modal copy: short consequence line like 'Rotating will immediately invalidate the previous secret; services using it may fail until updated.' Add 'Read more' to docs.

devin: Button ordering: follow platform standard (primary on right). Tests were confused by primary-left on destructive flows. Normalize to primary-right for consistency.

luis-bot: deploy-bot: design-proposal/cred-drawer-v3 pushed to staging at sha=b7a3f2. Preview: https://staging.redwood.example/preview/cred-drawer-v3

maya: Action items: 1) Update copy variants and add aria-live to toast. 2) Karla to add keyboard/a11y acceptance criteria. 3) DevEx to flip primary button placement in kit. 4) Sam to add microcopy about session expiry + rotate hint.

sam: Acceptance examples: screen reader announces revoke failure toast; after failure, focus lands on retry; disabled CTA has keyboard-focusable tooltip; rotate modal shows consequence + docs link.

karla: Add unit tests for contrast and focus ring at desktop and mobile breakpoints.

maya: I'll push updated mocks + copy by EOD. Thanks all :rocket:
